newsitem.title: GERMANY: German labour office sees up to 4.3 mln jobless.
newsitem.headline: German labour office sees up to 4.3 mln jobless.

text.p: German Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda on Tuesday said he did not expect much room for improvement in labour market in the summer and added that jobless totals could reach 4.3 million this year.

"The summer months are not going to see much growth," he said. "I would assume we will see improvements in September, October and November and we will need this improvement to reach our expectations for average annual unemployment of 4.2 to 4.3 million for the year."
